entries.title: Notepad identity and launch
entries.content: Use AUMID Microsoft.WindowsNotepad_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App. The launch PID is not the window owner; resolve windows through EnumWindows and GetWindowThreadProcessId.

entries.title: Editor selector
entries.content: The editor AutomationId is empty. Prefer Document plus RichEditD2DPT, then Edit plus Edit for legacy Notepad, then localized structural fallback.

entries.title: Text conventions
entries.content: UIA read returns bare CR. Canonical form is LF. Normalize CRLF to LF before CR to LF. Compare postconditions only on canonical text.

entries.title: Undo capability
entries.content: Ctrl+Z is declared by the adapter, but UIA SetValue is one whole-document action. Capture an L1 content snapshot before writes; Ctrl+Z is not the only rollback path.

entries.title: Known pitfalls
entries.content: Save As is a cross-process Shell dialog. Closing an unsaved tab opens a three-way Save/Don't Save/Cancel dialog defaulting to Cancel. Large files should use the file channel.
